name: A. Young
role: Medora resident who advertised a strayed mare; gun club member
bio: A. Young of Medora narrowly escaped injury in November 1884 when a stuck cartridge exploded and broke the breech of his Winchester. From November 1884 to March 1885 he ran a 'Strayed or Stolen' notice in the paper, and in March 1885 he found the missing mare dead in a sink hole about a hundred yards from his shack. That same month he scored 50 in a Bad Lands Gun Club shoot.
